performance_case.causal_mechanism: A credential-free point-in-time source may add a distinct BTC risk-state signal beyond spot candles, spot order flow, carry and derived price shocks; a source is useful only if its timestamp and semantics can be frozen prospectively without operational burden overwhelming its incremental learning value.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch may rank exactly four official source families and authorize at most one later source-design task. It cannot retrieve values, implement or deploy a source, define a factor, direction, threshold or horizon, register a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, change canonical state or schedule, or perform any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A future independently preregistered spot-only admission mechanism could reduce adverse paths only after point-in-time evidence and equal-capital drawdown tests; all predictive and economic value remains MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Adding several free feeds would create continuity, schema-drift and multiple-testing costs while delaying evidence on the two active lanes. Selecting no more than one source preserves capacity and closes low-information or operationally expensive branches before implementation.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The audit itself cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Its value is concentrating the next source-design cycle on at most one genuinely incremental, deterministic and maintainable evidence family while preventing redundant data collection from masquerading as strategy production.
